method: Only official data is used. MICHELIN restaurant pages publish street addresses incl. ZIP codes; those addresses are grouped below to show where starred restaurants cluster, and hotels with a verified ZIP are matched to same-ZIP restaurants. Same-ZIP counts are a static, verifiable cluster view, NOT the requested 'within 1 hour by subway or bus' count. That travel-time test requires a dated route/time result from the MTA Trip Planner, which is not a static official value. Because the rule says never infer or fill in values, the travel-time-based counts and the Michelin-density hotel ranking remain blank and flagged unverified. A verified-attribute ranking and a real dated price ranking are supplied instead, using only values actually published on official pages.
cluster_scope: 13 starred restaurants whose current MICHELIN pages were fetched and verified line by line (sample of the 69 starred restaurants in the current official listing).

travel_time.why: MTA does not publish a static hotel→restaurant travel-time matrix; the official Trip Planner computes a dated, time-specific result and requires a manual query.

verified_attribute_rule: 1 point each for: private bathroom confirmed; queen-or-larger bed confirmed; street address confirmed on an official page; ZIP code confirmed on an official page; official transit information confirmed; an official fee/price basis published; a dated 7-night total published. Only fields with a non-blank official value score. This is a count of verified information, not a quality score and not a Michelin-density ranking.
